topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe I'm stuck in this mess. All I did was use a few quotes from an article, and I cited them properly. Now, I’m facing accusations of plagiarism. This is ridiculous. I worked hard on that assignment, spent countless hours researching, and now it’s as if none of that matters. They act like I did something unforgivable. I know the rules, I followed them. I even double-checked everything. It’s not fair. I want this cleared up, and I want it cleared up now.
